messages:
dena: Quick follow-up from the onboarding RFC — telemetry sampling for admit/prober. We need to pick a pragmatic default that balances observability and cost.

sam_k: +1. what are the concrete signals you want by default? latency, golden-match, fail_reason?

dena: baseline signals: p50/p95 latency, kv_cache_miss, inference_error_type, golden_match_score (where available), input_seqlen_bin. For cost reasons I propose stratified sampling (by model_size and seqlen_bin) at ~1%, but escalate to full capture for any request that triggers a smoke or bench failure.

vic_parker: Important: we must strip PII before storing traces. Also surface-only fingerprints for models (no raw prompt retention unless customer opts in). KMS + redact pipeline required for Private deploys.

sam_k: sounds good. how do you imagine the sampling toggle sits in the stack? admit layer? bench harness? both?

dena: sampling at admit entry for perf/infra signals. Bench/smoke harness should request full captures for golden evaluation paths and return a capture token so admit can attach the same fingerprint if needed. Practically: small envelope at admit with fingerprint + sampling-tag; heavy payloads only when sampling decides to fully persist.

maria: ops-bot just posted infra note: "New low-cost event store available: ingest-archive-v2.0 — cheaper retention for sampled telemetry" link: https://internal.redwood/integrations/ingest-archive-v2

sam_k: config sketch:
```
sampling:
  mode: stratified
  strata: ["model_size", "seqlen_bin"]
  base_rate: 0.01
  on_fail_capture_rate: 1.0
  retain_days: 7
  redact_policy: "pii-lite"
```

dena: also add an opt-in flag for full debug capture per-customer and a short TTL for debug artifacts. We should avoid exploding storage when a model regressions floods captures.

vic_parker: on compatibility checks: include a short binary fingerprint + runtime ABI version in every capture so offline checks can quickly decide if a captured example is relevant to a given runtime.

sam_k: who owns the telemetry schema & the admit handshake contract? I can take the schema if dena files the RFC follow-up with open questions.

dena: I will open the follow-up RFC this afternoon. action items: dena - RFC + schema PR, sam_k - implement sampling toggle + unit tests, vic_parker - redact/KMS checklist, maria - validate ingest-archive-v2 quotas for 1% stratified capture. We will add a canary that forces full capture for 1% of canary traffic to validate end-to-end pipeline.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: sampling feature flag rollout will be staged to dev -> canary -> prod, notify #eng-oncall on canary stage.

sam_k: ok, I'll draft the schema and post in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
